experiment: DRNAS NeuroFlow V7.9 prospective selective CDCL 1024 conflict checkpoint; original GBD polynomial multiplication
selection: 18 predeclared previously UNTESTED original GBD polynomial multiplication CNFs (nine SAT nine UNSAT), hash-ascending within published SAT label. First SAT/UNSAT become pilots, remaining 16 prospective holdout. Identifiers, label and author fixed from public GBD metadata. Size-only exclusions <=80MB uncompressed, <=25MB compressed; no replacements. Absolutely no selection from solver runtimes. SHA256 freeze preflight BEFORE V7.9 compilation or evaluation. No overlap with prior V7.8 / polynomial-3repeat 20 originals.
methodology: Same unchanged CaDiCaL rel-3.0.1; 9 modes; three repeats; max 15 s per attempt; randomized paired order; PAR2 timeout=30s. No P vs NP implication. Observe 1024 unhinted conflicts then selectively permit next 512 hinted conflicts. Avoid family or answer labels in runtime selector.
